item.title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Sequoia is consolidating into a smaller, Bay Area–centered firm, shutting down the programs and offices it built during a 20-year expansion while announcing roughly $10 billion in new funds.

item.title: I tried Apple’s Siri Recaps. They’re surprisingly useful — and a little unsettling
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple's AI-powered Siri Recaps won me over in just one day, despite my privacy reservations. But there's still room for improvement.

item.title: Google faces backlash for plan that would turn off Search for schools that restrict AI
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Politicians on the left, like NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan, accused Google of acting as an unregulated monopoly.

item.title: Titan OS raises $46 million to expand its smart TV OS internationally
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Titan OS has raised $110 million in funding to date.

item.title: Revolut’s valuation jumps 53% to $115B in new share sale as it prepares to launch US bank
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Glade Brook, Coatue, and T. Rowe Price were among the investors that led the share sale.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Doors open at 9 a.m. ET in Boston
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Today is the day to join TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 in Boston's SoWa Power Station. Register now to join this founder-focused conference today.

item.title: Canva lays off over 1,200 people amid slowing growth
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Canva is cutting 22% of its staff as it faces its 'hardest year' yet.

item.title: India’s EloElo nabs $80M from NBCUniversal to bet on the country’s rising microdrama market
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: More than 118 million users watch microdramas every month as the serialized format has taken off in India. EloElo's Story TV is one of the top apps for microdramas, with over 33 million active users, according to analysts.

item.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

item.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

item.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

item.title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Palantir's U.S. commercial revenue surpassed U.S. government revenue for the first time ever.

item.title: Orbital Matter 3D-printed the first rigid beam in the vacuum of space
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: An in-space construction first could be an enabler for the space data centers of the future.

item.title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Cybersecurity experts have long warned of the persistent and patient threat from North Korea's long-running hacks. The world's largest crypto exchange was still caught off-guard.

item.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin

item.title: Reddit tests ads in search results as traffic declines and growth concerns mount
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez

item.description: Hillary Clinton's 2016 political gaffe has become an irony-shrouded rallying cry for jaded young voters who still dare to hope for change.

item.title: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The Luce, Ferrari's first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, is "fully allocated" through 2027, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna.

item.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

item.title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
